scripts/native_binary_builder.py

Python · Tier B

Build native Server and Gateway distributions with private CPython runtimes.

Usage

Run through build_binary.sh on the target host with CMake and native tools.

Inputs

Component/target options, dependency lock or wheelhouse, signing configuration and the current source snapshot; --release requires reviewed clean-source inputs.

Side effects

Acquires dependencies unless offline, runs tests, compiles and optionally signs/notarizes artifacts, then writes outputs and provenance to the release directory.

Cleanup

Removes temporary staging unless --keep-stage; --clean removes native build work.

@see build_binary.sh

@see docs/native-distribution.md

trust_artifact 175 Apply requested platform signatures and verify the resulting native artifact. macOS notarization submits a temporary archive, checks acceptance and staples the ticket; remove that archive even on failure. Signing errors propagate.

main 252 Validate native build options and assemble the selected component release outputs. Own the temporary snapshot, private runtime, compiler and validation sequence. Official builds enforce clean source, provenance and trust gates; failures propagate and staging is removed in finally unless explicitly retained.
